presentation.summary: Matches films TMDB does not list, such as fan films and fan edits, by their IMDb ID.
presentation.description_markdown:
Looks films up on [OMDb](https://www.omdbapi.com/), which is built from IMDb's data, and supplies the title, year, plot, genres, runtime, cast and poster. It is meant as the last source in a library's list, behind TMDB.

OMDb's free key allows 1,000 requests a day, and Silo asks every source on every lookup, so the plugin only calls OMDb for a film with an IMDb ID and no TMDB ID, such as a folder named `Film (2010) {imdb-tt18183916}` or an IMDb ID entered in the Match dialog. Title searches are off unless you turn them on. Answers are kept for a day, and the plugin stops at its daily limit.
presentation.setup_markdown:
1. Get a free API key at https://www.omdbapi.com/apikey.aspx.
2. Paste it under **OMDb**, save, and run **Check Connection**.
3. In each movie library's metadata settings, keep this source below TMDB.
4. For a film TMDB cannot find, add `{imdb-tt…}` to its folder name, or enter the IMDb ID in the Match dialog.

global_config_schema.title: OMDb
global_config_schema.description: Your OMDb API key and how many requests the plugin may spend.

fields.label: Search by title
fields.description: Also search OMDb by title when no IMDb ID is known. Each automatic match then costs a request, so leave it off for large libraries.

fields.label: Daily request limit
fields.description: The plugin stops calling OMDb after this many requests in a day (UTC). The free key allows 1,000.
